node.statement: Algebraic amplification of bijectivity. By def-ha-map, T_1=Ha^Q_{P,R} is linear, and by hypothesis it has a two-sided linear inverse S. By the meaning of amplification, T_n=id_{M_n} tensor T_1 acts entrywise. Therefore id_{M_n} tensor S is a two-sided inverse: on an elementary tensor a tensor y, (id tensor T_1)(id tensor S)(a tensor y)=a tensor y and the reverse composition is identical, and linearity extends the identities to the algebraic matrix tensor spaces. Thus every T_n is bijective, independently of any norm estimate.
